nodes.question: How do some brands increase transparency in specific areas to address noncompliance?
nodes.answer: Some brands choose to reactively report selectively in certain areas to increase transparency and combat noncompliance. By focusing on specific areas, they aim to mitigate the severity of social and environmental failures in those aspects.
